summary.shortDescription: A 5850mAh energy-oriented tabless 21700 cell with a 20A continuous rating.
summary.description: The RH60 is Reliance's energy-series 21700. Battery Mooch tested two batches and found consistent performance, approximately 6000mAh measured capacity, and a defensible 20A continuous value. Reliance's 30A temperature-limited context is not the proposed runtime limit.

sources.title: Bench Test Results: Reliance RH60 - 20A 5850mAh 21700
sources.limitations: Full exact-model report text was retrieved through the ECF activity feed and reviewed; the feed is a presentation of the original forum report.

claims.statement: Reliance identifies INR21700-RH60 as a distinct energy-series 21700 model.
The current production record gives 5850mAh minimum or standard capacity and the test measured about 6000mAh.
The current product matrix lists 20A maximum continuous discharge.
The retrieved exact-model report found consistent performance across two RH60 batches, measured about 6000mAh, and considered 20A continuous reasonable; 30A is temperature-limited.

safetyFindings.summary: The tester distinguishes the 20A continuous value from a higher temperature-limited context that increases sag and aging.
safetyFindings.runtimeImplication: Use 20A for the proposed calculator profile.
